authoritative_principle: ONE BUSINESS CAPABILITY → ONE CANONICAL UI OWNER → ONE CANONICAL WORKFLOW

TRIP_DISPATCH_AND_LOADING.description: Dispatching new cargo trips and logging origin weighbridge tickets

Door_A_Field_Workstation.persistence_mechanism: Online: Local client-side in-memory state via tripEngineService; Offline: IndexedDB 'trips' queue and outbox replay via outboxService

TRIP_UNLOADING_AND_COMPLETION.description: Logging destination arrival, unloading process, and final cargo completion with weight tolerance variance checks

Door_A_Field_Workstation.persistence_mechanism: Strictly local in-memory state manipulation via tripEngineService with no outbox queueing or server sync fallback

MASTER_DATA_ADMINISTRATION.description: Managing primary master-data records including Carriers, Materials, and Driver-Truck rosters

Door_A_Project_Workspace.persistence_mechanism: Direct live Firestore repository writes and real-time document subscriptions

Door_B_Master_Data_Modules.persistence_mechanism: Authenticated: Real-time Firestore write; Unauthenticated: Local state mock builder

GOOGLE_WORKSPACE_SYNC.description: Configuring shared drives, directory structures, and forcing live synchronization with Google Sheets/Drive

Door_A_Project_Workspace.persistence_mechanism: Direct project document property updates in Firestore

Door_B_Workspace_Integration_Tab.persistence_mechanism: Shared drive status queries and global sheets import controls

IMPORT_CENTER_SUPERVISION.description: Uploading, parsing, normalizing, and resolving Excel/CSV cargo rosters through a 12-stage validation pipeline

Door_A_Standalone_Import_Center.persistence_mechanism: Transient local React state and in-memory ImportCenterService mappings

Door_B_Nested_Field_Supervision.persistence_mechanism: Nested copy of the standalone ImportCenterView rendered inside the Supervisor workstation

gap_classifications.title: Online Workstation Outbox Disconnection
gap_classifications.description: Field operation views use local in-memory simulation state (tripEngineService) for online pathways. Only the loading operator's offline route utilizes the sync outbox, creating a critical partition where online dispatches and unloading transitions never reach the server or Firestore.
gap_classifications.convergence_plan: Unify both online and offline UI pathways in field workstations to queue operations directly into the Outbox, allowing the outbox replay engine to synchronously dispatch to server REST APIs for online users, and asynchronously for offline users.

gap_classifications.title: Unloading Completion Server Bypass
gap_classifications.description: The destination arrival, weight ticket entry, and variance calculations are entirely routed to the in-memory mock engine. The server-side transition API is completely bypassed, leaving completed trips unsaved in live Firestore.
gap_classifications.convergence_plan: Re-architect UnloadingOperatorView to create a 'RECORD_RECEIPT' action, queuing it in the Outbox to execute the server-side TripService transition and calculate authoritative financials.

gap_classifications.title: Duplicate Master Data Administrative Doors
gap_classifications.description: Both MasterDataView and ProjectWorkspaceView provide duplicate entry points to manage project roster entities. Each implements distinct UI views, search fields, normalization helpers, and validation forms.
gap_classifications.convergence_plan: Establish ProjectWorkspaceView as the single canonical owner for project-scoped master data management, and refactor MasterDataView to read from canonical repositories with read-only metrics, redirecting any creation or edit operations directly to the workspace view.

gap_classifications.title: Separated Google Workspace Entrypoints
gap_classifications.description: Project-level Google Drive folder mappings are configured inside the Project Workspace, whereas global spreadsheet imports and sync health checks are managed on a distinct Workspace Integration tab, splitting the workspace capability across two disjoint menus.
gap_classifications.convergence_plan: Unify the Google Workspace configuration into a cohesive tab inside ProjectWorkspaceView, restricting the global tab purely to super-admin diagnostic reports.

gap_classifications.title: Redundant Embedded Import Center Views
gap_classifications.description: The entire 12-stage ImportCenterView is embedded directly inside the Field Supervision workstation under the Imports tab, violating strict role boundaries and duplicating active React rendering.
gap_classifications.convergence_plan: Replace the embedded ImportCenterView inside the field supervisor's view with a simple diagnostic log list, pointing supervisors to the dedicated Import Center tab for active batch corrections.
